paragraphs.text: Understand what information LAMID ONE uses, what may progress or update over time, which permission allows it, where it belongs, and what controls apply.
Account, workspace, interaction, uploaded, connected-source, and usage information are handled according to the service and permissions that apply.
Information is used for defined purposes such as delivering the service, supporting workflows, maintaining security, and improving permitted product behavior.
Personal, team, and organizational information is separated according to the relevant workspace, role, and permissions.
See what information is available, where it came from, what it supports, and which controls you can use.
